description: NativeClaw v2.0 Cron Schedule — Default jobs after install.

crons.name: session-audit
crons.prompt: Daily session audit. Read state.json. Check sessions. Write checkpoint.

crons.name: morning-brief
crons.prompt: Morning brief: calendar, reminders, homework, daily log carryover.

crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Heartbeat check. Read HEARTBEAT.md. Alert only if needed. Quiet hours 9:15 PM - 5:15 AM.

crons.name: task-queue-recovery
crons.prompt: Retry any pending/rate-limited tasks in queue.json.

crons.name: qmd-reindex
crons.prompt: Reindex QMD memory files. Pull shared-memory updates.

crons.name: daily-newsletter
crons.prompt: Generate and send Whet's Daily newsletter.
